title: Dermoscope ABCD
description: Deterministic dermoscopic lesion preprocessing (dark-corner masking, DullRazor hair removal, Shades of Gray color constancy), Otsu lesion border segmentation, and experimental automated ABCD morphometry.

analyze.title: Analyze lesion (ABCD)
analyze.description: Run DullRazor hair removal, Shades of Gray color constancy, CIE L*a*b* Otsu lesion border segmentation, and experimental automated A/B/C morphometry (with optional clinician-entered D for Stolz TDS) on one dermoscopy image.

image.description: One 2D dermoscopic photograph in JPEG or PNG format

removeHair.description: Apply DullRazor directional morphological closing and bilinear hair inpainting

colorConstancy.description: Apply Shades of Gray (Minkowski p = 6) illuminant color constancy

thresholdBias.description: Offset added to the automatic Otsu segmentation threshold (-0.3 expands, +0.3 tightens the lesion border)

pixelsPerMm.description: Optional spatial calibration in pixels per millimetre on the input image (0 leaves measurements in pixels)

differentialStructures.description: Optional clinician/educational count of dermoscopic differential structures (1–5) used to compute Stolz Total Dermoscopy Score; 0 leaves D unscored (A/B/C only)
